name: Omnipotence
overview: Scripture reveals God's omnipotence as the all-encompassing power by which He sustains and governs all things, demonstrated in Christ who upholds creation by His powerful word and accomplished our purification through His sacrifice (Hebrews 1:3). Jesus affirms that what is impossible for humans is entirely possible with God, emphasizing His limitless ability to accomplish His will (Matthew 19:26). The final proclamation in Revelation celebrates the Lord God as omnipotent, reigning with unmatched authority and strength (Revelation 19:6). Together, these verses affirm that God's omnipotence is central to His nature and redemptive work in Christ.
